summary: This directory is responsible for transforming raw XML data into structured object formats. It provides the necessary logic to interpret XML content and map it into a representation usable by the rest of the application.
responsibilities: Mapping XML structures to domain objects
relationships: The XML parser consumes raw string data to produce structured objects.
Structured objects serve as the output format for the parsing process.
designDecisions: Encapsulation of XML parsing logic within a dedicated module
Use of object-based transformation for parsed data
